Northampton Cycling Club Wednesday A/B Ride

Northampton, MA · Downtown · Road

Northampton Cycling Club Wednesday A/B Ride is a road group ride in Northampton, MA. Schedule: Wednesday evenings, April–September; start time on the club calendar, from Downtown Northampton. Pace: 15–18 mph together to Hatfield, then A and B split.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Northampton Cycling Club Wednesday A/B Ride group ride

The club's long-running Wednesday ride rolls out of downtown, up Route 9 and over to Hatfield at a conversational pace, then the A group goes. Expect real climbing, 2,000 to 6,000 feet. Routes change weekly and are posted for GPS. Newcomers are steered to the Monday introductory ride first.
